common_treatment: same current domain authority (AUTHORITY_LOCK_v1 + freshness artifact when WS222 seals it)
same mandatory fixture contract (COMMON_FIXTURE_MANIFEST_v1, 135/135, frozen seeds)
same evidence vocabulary (evidence-vocab-v1; legacy prose only via versioned map)
same process-isolation rule (one game per clean process; H07)
same RNG/replay semantic bar (attribution + tapes + clean-process proof; WS218-Tape-v1 shape)
same hidden-info bar (actor-scoped + honeycard negatives; H06)
same scoring rule (gate PASS iff all mandatory items PASS+RUNTIME_VERIFIED and current)
mechanics_vs_standards: Candidate-specific harness mechanics are allowed (drivers, seams, projections, mappings). Candidate-specific evidence standards are NOT allowed: no alternative verdict vocabularies, no weaker satisfying pairs, no construction-counts-as-behavior, no README-as-evidence.
scope: Minimum common treatment for admitted candidates in full qualification. Pre-qualification admission (the bar) and Provider Selection are separate decisions; this contract binds the qualification comparison itself.
